theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Dangote Refinery Set to Become Africa’s Biggest Listed Company
top_news.summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE will rank as the biggest company with a primary listing in Africa once it makes its trading debut in Lagos, far exceeding the size of the next-largest business on the continent.

top_news.title: Huang Boost Fades Quickly as AI Fears Sink TSMC, SK Hynix Shares
top_news.summary: Asian stock market enthusiasm over the resurrection of Jensen Huang’s career evaporated Wednesday as investors refocused on worries around the global AI trade.

top_news.title: Australia Edges China Out of Pacific Foothold in Solomon Islands
top_news.summary: Australia signed a new treaty with the Solomon Islands aimed at rolling back China’s access to the Pacific, partly reversing Beijing’s gains in the region three years ago that alarmed the US and its allies.

top_news.title: Metals Mixed After Major Selloff as Traders Await US Inflation
top_news.summary: Copper ticked higher and aluminum steadied after a major selloff across metals on Tuesday, as traders awaited US inflation data that will feed into the Federal Reserve’s next decision on interest rates.

top_news.title: Stock Losses Build as AI Trade Falters, Oil Drops: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks sold off and futures signaled further weakness as doubts over the durability of the artificial intelligence boom drove a retreat from technology shares. Treasuries advanced on haven demand.

top_news.title: Starbucks Is Said to Engage Banks for Sale of Japan Business
top_news.summary: Starbucks Corp. has tapped advisers to prepare for a potential sale of its Japan business for several billion dollars, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_news.title: Rakuten Credit Risk Surges After Yen Bond Offering Scrapped
top_news.summary: Rakuten Group Inc.’s credit risk surged by the most since April 2025 after the company scrapped plans to raise about ¥150 billion ($942 million) in the bond market.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 25
top_news.summary: Oil slipped as traders weighed signs of rising supply against escalating attacks on vessels around the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Australia’s Hot Inflation Vindicates RBA’s Hawkish Policy Stance
top_news.summary: Australia’s core inflation unexpectedly accelerated in October, highlighting persistent price pressures in the economy and vindicating Reserve Bank officials’ hawkish commentary.

top_news.title: India Pension Funds Pivot to Bonds as Equity Exposure Nears Cap
top_news.summary: India’s biggest pension funds are directing more of their inflows to government bonds as they near a regulatory threshold on equity investments, just as local stocks rebound from a bruising selloff.
